attacksRun.attack: Decision clause 2 asserts the G24 harness specification is 'measured authored' while live file 08 and adopted D-150 both record the same named identifier as 'not authored' — an unauthorized status flip by assertion in an entry that declines to edit file 08
attacksRun.detail: Raised as a candidate MUST-FIX and pursued to the point of refutation. The tension is real on its face: file 08's DR-G24 cell reads 'named: harness.DR-G24.preview-analyze-well-formed-admission.preview (D-150; not authored; not QUALIFIED)', and adopted D-150 states 'Not authored.' of that identifier. Three lines of evidence defeat the finding. First, the sentence is settled reviewed vocabulary, not an innovation: the identical construction 'G<n> harness specification is measured authored and not QUALIFIED. Not QUALIFIED.' appears in 23 prior coordinator-decision drafts, including the contiguous run D-192 through D-198, every one of which was adopted at dual CONSENT with 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Second, the vocabulary distinguishes four separable things, and the recorded artifact draws the distinction explicitly: OBL-G24-HARNESS-SPEC records that 'the specification now exists at harness.DR-G24.preview-analyze-well-formed-admission.preview.v1 ... CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED; not QUALIFIED', while OBL-G24-FX-AUTHORING cites D-056 clause 5 that 'authoring fixtures remains design work, distinct from the harness specification, distinct from live-cell naming, and distinct from execution'. The register cell's 'not authored' attaches to the harness as an executable, which remains unauthored. Third, the claim is measurable and true: the specification artifact exists on disk and hashes to 9d8fb91395d683d40093c4e962f1e1e44cd0d0db84fce424e34eceeedb663ef3, exactly the value v3 pins in basedOn.g24v1. The sentence also carries 'not QUALIFIED' twice, which is precisely the guard against the escalation this attack posits. No status token is flipped and no file-08 cell is disturbed.
